# Courage, Strength, and Power to Conquer

### Swami Chidananda Giri • Yogoda Satsanga Society of India

Welcome and blessings. Swami Chidananda Giri shares inspiring spiritual truths on how to draw upon the courage, strength, and power stored in our souls to conquer every limitation. Under the protective guidance of our Guru, we can stand unshakable in any storm.

### Drawing Devotion from the Source of Power

Our soul is not made of weakness or doubt. In deep meditation, as we connect with the Cosmic Energy, we receive a powerful flow of vitality and peace. This spiritual current energizes our mind, dispelling all shadows of fear.

> "Do not look to the worldly forecasts for your courage. Look to the quiet fountain of peace in your spine, where the Divine Mother is ready to pour His infinite light and strength into your heart."

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Fix Your Gaze:** Concentrate at the Christ center between the eyebrows during your prayers and meditation.
* **Keep Calm:** When difficulties arise, take a deep breath and tell yourself: *"I am a child of God, and nothing can destroy my peace."*
* **Sadhana Practice:** Sit for longer sessions on the weekend to deepen your practice.
* **Work as Worship:** Offer the fruits of all actions to the Lord in your heart.

In His light you are secure. Jai Maharaj!
rawText: We possess an infinite supply of courage and power within our souls. By focusing our minds in deep meditation, we receive the spiritual strength to dissolve all fear...
